goal: Preserve language-proposed cost structure, behavioral inverse fitting and fixed-decision risk auditing; examine stronger computation baselines and explicitly declared noise-envelope sensitivity.
novelty: Classical set inclusion, weak duality and LP basis reuse; no new-theorem or first-use claim.
target: AAAI main-conference full paper is aspirational; this study cannot establish readiness.
primary_estimand: Candidate minus stronger baseline correct resolution fraction; average two noise conditions per independent family-seed instance, then average the 3 fixed families equally.
sensitivity_endpoint_budget_contract: Nominal and upper checks each have their own cooperative time and history-oracle limit; total work includes both checks. This is a correctness/utility study, not a matched-LP speed comparison.
sensitivity_primary_outcomes: actual false-safe count at nominal and primary upper budget
sensitivity_caveat: The primary upper cap equals a known synthetic generator limit, not a learned or validated real-world cap. Lower and higher caps are predeclared sensitivity conditions, not picked after seeing outcomes.
candidate_selection: Same old unregularized point estimator, fit once from history before every comparison or profile; fixed deployment decision across all methods and budgets. No hidden truth is passed to algorithms.
generator: Unchanged comparison_cases.py; 2 parameters, 8 histories, one deployment context. Fixed generator families, no external-data claim.

analysis.interval: 95% percentile stratified paired instance bootstrap, exploratory precision only; no finite-sample coverage or power guarantee.
analysis.missingness: All planned cases remain in denominators; failed, missing and unresolved method runs score zero. Sensitivity failures remain in counts and block a zero-error completeness claim.
analysis.replication_unit: 120 independent family-seed instances per cohort; noise conditions, caps, budgets and methods are repeated measures. Three fixed families are not sampled domains.
analysis.secondary: All three LP budgets, all caps, timing, row counts, simplex iterations and actually applied basis reuse are descriptive; no selecting significant metrics.
analysis.promotion_rule: Candidate advantage >=0.10 and primary interval lower>0, all planned comparison runs complete and no invalid conditional certificate. Only a continuation signal, not novelty or generalization.
analysis.negative_rule: Preserve unfavorable results; do not replace software default because of an exploratory speed result.
analysis.correctness_gate: Any invalid conditional bound/witness/status blocks a success claim; repair requires a separately identified version and new output directory.
analysis.precision_planning: A fixed 120 instances per cohort chosen for a bounded replication study. No power guarantee. With paired values in [-1,1], the worst-case standard-error bound is 1/sqrt(120)=0.0913; report observed uncertainty.

freeze: Local protocol, full source snapshots, hashes, runtime metadata and planned order saved before experiment outputs. Not public preregistration.
regression: Separately rerun the prior known false-safe counterexample; do not count it as independent new evidence.
deferred: Real LLM structure extraction/repair, model comparisons, human feedback and external data are not run; record as pending with null metrics.
limitations: A wider noise budget cannot repair an incorrect parameter box, omitted feature, missing hard constraint or changed deployment costs. Endpoint checks do not identify a critical noise threshold.
run_order: Shuffle family-seed-noise blocks globally, budget order within block, and method order within budget; sensitivity instance and cap orders shuffled. All computations serial on this host.
language_scope: No new model calls. Archived 2026-10-20 language evidence is historical and separate from this synthetic held-out study. Deferred language-risk benchmark stays unmeasured.
failure_policy: All planned denominators retained; execution failures and interrupted attempts are immutable and score zero. Automatic retries forbidden; changed methods require a separately frozen version and fresh seeds.
resume_policy: Validate source/runtime/protocol/snapshot and evidence hashes; no refit of saved candidates; missing outcome after a recorded attempt becomes an interrupted failure.
